Attached: 4 images

Build a support-reply library: collect the questions you hear most, write the answer once properly, let AI draft and you decide, file them where you can find them, and review one reply a week. A template is a starting point, not the answer. Use it to get the facts right, then answer the person in front of you. Link in bio. #AIexplained #smallbusiness #productivity
